mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals that the economy is approaching capacity constraints, which triggers profit-taking and risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion despite rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annual inflation rate above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) signals central bank tightening and rising real interest rates, which compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index) signals an economic slowdown, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) indicate a stagflationary regime, which erodes corporate margins and increases risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
